Compatibility: Avian

Red-billed yarhuda, beyond just their red beaks, have particularly rigid and sharp feathers. They also have some of the loosest and fastest-growing feathers of any yarhuda, molting more often as a result. Using this to their advantage, cornered red-bills pluck their own feathers for use as weaponized darts, or kick up storms of molted feathers to slice into attackers. Feather plucking is a fairly painful proposition, but worth it in a pinch.
